title: Gifts
dek: Holiday 2026 gifts that showed up in this season's gift guides, sorted by budget and by who they are for.

boards.title: Under $50
boards.dek: Small coffee gifts that do one thing well.

boards.title: Under $100
boards.dek: Food gifts that get used up, with no clutter left behind.

boards.title: For the cook
boards.dek: Picks from Food Network's 2026 guide for serious home cooks.

boards.title: For the coffee person
boards.dek: Pour-over and brewing upgrades that don't repeat the espresso gear in Coffee.

boards.title: Splurge
boards.dek: Bigger gifts from this fall's men's gift guides.

items.name: Prismo AeroPress Attachment
items.why: A pressure valve that screws onto an AeroPress or AeroPress Go and builds about 1 to 2 bars, enough for a concentrated, crema-topped shot. It comes with a reusable 70-micron stainless filter, so no paper filters to buy.

items.name: Dwell Dripper Kit
items.why: Verve's own pour-over brewer: a bottomless, BPA-free silicone dripper that comes with a measuring scoop and in several colors. Engadget put it on its 2026 coffee gift list at $30.

items.name: Wave 185 Stainless Dripper
items.why: A flat-bottomed stainless pour-over dripper that slows the flow of water so the brew is easier to control. Espresso Parts put it in the under-$50 tier of its 2026 gift guide.

items.name: V60 02 Ceramic Dripper
items.why: The cone pour-over most cafés use, in heat-holding ceramic and a range of colors. Espresso Parts' 2026 guide lists it as an under-$50 gift.

items.name: AeroPress Go
items.why: The compact travel version of the AeroPress, which Espresso Parts lists under $50 for travelers and small kitchens. The Fellow Prismo fits it too.

items.name: Levain Cookie Tin Gift Set
items.why: Eight of the New York bakery's thick cookies, each bagged and tied, in a blue keepsake tin; flavor sets include Chocolate Chip Walnut and a vegan, gluten-free option. Forbes named it the best food gift in its 2026 men's guide.

items.name: Crushed Vinegars Gift Set
items.why: Four 8-oz bottles of fruit vinegar (tangerine, blueberry, strawberry and cucumber lemon balsamic) in a gift box. Food Network's October 2026 guide for serious home cooks picked Kosterina's crushed fruit vinegars.

items.name: Butcher Block, 12 x 18 in
items.why: A two-sided edge-grain maple board made in the USA, 1.6 inches thick and 8 lb, so it stays put while you carve. It is on Food Network's October 2026 list of gifts for serious home cooks.

items.name: Silicone Stretch Lids, 6-Pack
items.why: Six silicone lids from 2.5 to 8.25 inches that stretch over bowls, cans and cut fruit in place of plastic wrap. GIR's stretch covers made Food Network's 2026 serious-home-cook guide.

items.name: V60 Drip Scale and Timer
items.why: A small pour-over scale with a built-in timer that reads to 0.1 g, so the brewer can weigh beans and water instead of guessing. Espresso Parts lists it in the $50 to $200 tier of its 2026 guide.

items.name: Stagg EKG Pro Electric Kettle, Matte Black and Walnut
items.why: A gooseneck kettle that holds a set temperature to the degree and pours a slow, steady stream for pour-over. It is the kettle in Espresso Parts' 2026 gift guide.

items.name: Pietro Manual Coffee Grinder, Silver
items.why: A hand grinder with 58 mm vertical flat burrs and a solid build. It is the hand grinder in Espresso Parts' 2026 gift guide.

items.name: Rebrew Aiden Precision Coffee Maker (refurbished)
items.why: Fellow's own refurbished Aiden, a drip brewer with roast-specific presets that Engadget put on its 2026 coffee gift list. It is $100 under a new one, with a one-year functional warranty, but sales are final.

items.name: Valet 7.5 in. Wireless Charger and Tray
items.why: A weighted nightstand tray in Nappa leather with a Qi2 pad for an iPhone and a USB-C port for a second device, plus room for keys and a watch. Forbes named it the best tech gift in its 2026 men's guide; a smaller 4.25-inch version adds faster 25W charging for $129.99.

items.name: Sonos Ace Headphones, Black
items.why: Sonos's noise-canceling wireless over-ear headphones, sold on Sonos's own site in black or soft white. They are on Forbes' 2026 men's gift guide.

items.name: Men's Sunday Element Jacket
items.why: A light, stretchy, moisture-wicking jacket for hikes and errands; Forbes called it the most popular pick in its 2026 men's gift guide.

items.name: Rare Cars: The World's Most Exclusive Rides
items.why: A large hardcover on the rarest cars, for the car person who already has the detailing kit. It was the luxury pick in Forbes' 2026 men's gift guide.
